explanation: Matches the boxdot conjecture in Jeřábek (arXiv 1308.0994) Section 1: L^{⊡ -1} = T implies L ⊆ T. `H` says ⊢_L φ^⊡ iff ⊢_T φ. `t` preserves variables and ⊥, commutes with implication (hence all Boolean connectives), and sends □φ to □φ^⊡ ∧ φ^⊡. `NormalModalLogic` has the usual closure conditions (K, MP, necessitation, substitution), and `KT` is K plus the T schema. The `research solved` tag agrees with the paper, which proves the conjecture. The notation parses as intended: `□t α & t α` is (□(t α)) ∧ (t α). Faithful.
